description: This file defines a mock class 'GstWrapperMock' for the 'IGstWrapper' interface, using Google Mock. It provides mock implementations for various GStreamer-related methods, including creation, manipulation, and querying of GStreamer objects, caps, structures, and messages. The class is used for unit testing components that depend on GStreamer functionality within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

classes.name: GstWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock class implementing the IGstWrapper interface for unit testing GStreamer interactions.

methods.name: gstCapsNewSimple
methods.description: Creates a new GstCaps with a simple media type and a list of properties, using variable arguments to specify property types and values.

methods.name: gstCapsSetSimple
methods.description: Sets multiple properties on a GstCaps object, with variable arguments specifying property names, types, and values.

methods.name: gstStructureNew
methods.description: Creates a new GstStructure with a specified name and properties, using variable arguments for property types and values.

methods.name: gstStructureSet
methods.description: Sets multiple properties on a GstStructure, with variable arguments for property names, types, and values.
